introduction: This spec wires AgentKit's `find_references` tool into agent-fox by adding its name to `ReadOnlyFileTools` so every phase of every tool (`triage`, `fix`, `spec`, `impl`) can call it, updating the two prompts that mention callers to name the tool, extending the repository map sentence, and updating the documentation that counts or names the read tools.

glossary.ReadOnlyFileTools: The package-level slice in internal/agentrun/policy.go listing the built-in tool names every read-only phase receives; currently six entries, becoming seven.
glossary.phase: One agent invocation inside a tool run, with its own system prompt, tool set, turn budget and cost cap, built by agentrun.Runner.Run.
glossary.tools.All: The AgentKit function that returns every built-in tool for a given workspace and index; called once per phase by registeredTools.

requirements.title: Add find_references to ReadOnlyFileTools
requirements.rationale: Following the pattern established by spec 15 for file_outline and find_symbol, adding the name to the shared slice is a one-line change that reaches every phase of every tool with no per-phase code change.

criteria.action: contain exactly the seven entries `read_file`, `list_files`, `find_files`, `search_files`, `file_outline`, `find_symbol` and `find_references`, in that order
not include `find_references` in MutatingTools, so AssertReadOnly passes for every read-only phase that registers the seven read tools

criteria.condition: a phase sets BuiltinTools to ReadOnlyFileTools (with or without execute or WriteFileTools appended)
criteria.action: include `find_references` in the resolved tool set returned to the phase
not include `find_references` in ShellTools, so the shell guard is unaffected

requirements.title: Fresh reference table per phase
requirements.rationale: Each phase calls tools.All once, so find_references builds its reference table from the current tree at that point, keeping fix and impl correct across tree changes between phases.

criteria.action: call tools.All exactly once per phase invocation, so each phase holds its own reference table built on its first find_references call

requirements.title: Prompts name find_references where they say callers
requirements.rationale: A model told to find callers but given no tool for it falls back to search_files with a regex, which returns false positives. Naming find_references in the same instruction steers the model to the better tool on its first attempt.

criteria.action: contain the string `find_references` in the step that currently says "Read the file, then its callers and callees", so the model discovers the tool without a trial call
contain the string `find_references` in the step that currently says "Read the file it lives in, its callers, and its tests", so the model discovers the tool without a trial call
retain the instruction to trace callers and callees, changing only the wording to name the tool, not removing the step or adding a new one
retain the instruction to read callers and tests, changing only the wording to name the tool, not removing the step or adding a new one

requirements.title: Repository map sentence mentions find_references
requirements.rationale: The Intro constant is the first text a model sees about navigation tools. Mentioning find_references there tells every phase about it before the tool list.

criteria.action: contain the string `find_references` and describe it as the tool for finding who calls or uses a declaration
continue to mention `read_file`, `file_outline`, `find_symbol`, `find_files` and `search_files` alongside `find_references`

requirements.title: toolsNote and renderGuidelines carry find_references automatically
requirements.rationale: Both functions iterate the registered tool set, so adding find_references to ReadOnlyFileTools is sufficient for the tool name and its PromptGuidelines to appear in every phase's system prompt.

criteria.condition: find_references is in the registered tool set of a phase
criteria.action: include `find_references` in the tool-availability sentence appended to the system prompt

criteria.condition: find_references carries a non-empty PromptGuidelines slice
criteria.action: render each guideline as a bullet under the Tool guidelines heading, with no agent-fox code change
replace every occurrence of "the six read tools" with "the seven read tools" and replace every occurrence of "six read tools" with "seven read tools"

list all seven read tools — `read_file`, `list_files`, `find_files`, `search_files`, `file_outline`, `find_symbol` and `find_references` — in the paragraph that defines the phrase and in the triage row that enumerates them
replace every occurrence of "six read tools" with "seven read tools" and list all seven including `find_references` wherever the six were previously enumerated
not add a new --preflight check entry for find_references; the existing symbol_backend check remains the sole entry for the symbol-table backend

requirements.title: Update navigation baseline tables in docs/development.md

criteria.action: include a `find_references` column in every navigation baseline table, placed after `find_symbol` and before `code_search`
set every cell in the `find_references` column to a dash in every existing row of every baseline table
update the jq snippet that reads the report files to extract `(.tool_calls.find_references // 0)` between `find_symbol` and `code_search`
update the introductory text of the navigation baseline section to say seven read-only file tools (was six) and name `find_references` alongside the others

requirements.title: WithCodeSearch and shared-list mutation safety
requirements.rationale: WithCodeSearch copies ReadOnlyFileTools before appending, so the shared slice is never grown. The existing mutation tests adapt to seven automatically because they compare len(ReadOnlyFileTools) before and after.

criteria.action: for any call with on=true, return a new slice of length len(ReadOnlyFileTools)+1 whose last element is `code_search`, without modifying the original ReadOnlyFileTools slice
for any call with on=false, return the input grant unchanged, with length equal to len(ReadOnlyFileTools)

execution_paths.title: A triage run registers find_references and the model sees it in the prompt

steps.action: calls RunPreflight, which reports the symbol_backend check (no new check for find_references)
calls tools.All and selects the seven ReadOnlyFileTools including find_references
appends the tool-availability sentence listing find_references to the system prompt
receives find_references in its tool set and may call it to locate callers of a declaration

execution_paths.title: Fix analyse phase names find_references in its prompt and registers the tool

steps.action: enters the analyse phase with BuiltinTools built from ReadOnlyFileTools plus execute
resolves the seven read tools plus execute, including find_references
passes because find_references is not in MutatingTools
reads the analysisSystemPrompt which names find_references in the step about tracing callers

execution_paths.title: Impl survey phase names find_references in its prompt and registers the tool

steps.action: enters the survey phase with BuiltinTools built from ReadOnlyFileTools plus execute
resolves the seven read tools plus execute, including find_references
passes because find_references is not in MutatingTools
reads the surveySystemPrompt which names find_references in the step about reading callers

execution_paths.title: Documentation reflects seven read tools throughout

steps.action: reads docs/model-usage.md and sees seven read tools listed in the phase table and defining paragraph
reads docs/cli.md and sees seven read tools listed in each tool's what-the-model-may-do section
reads docs/development.md and sees a find_references column in every baseline table with dashes in every cell
